opening.zh: 关于床位升级，我撤回申请。暂时。
opening.en: I’m withdrawing the mattress upgrade request. For now.

options.en: Learn to wash a cup first.

reply.zh: 你这位房东，很擅长增加任务。
reply.en: You’re very good at expanding the job description.

options.en: You’re good at applying for benefits.

reply.en: I can apply. I can also wait for you to approve.

opening_if.zh: 我脖子那边的证据，建议你不要销毁。
opening_if.en: Please don’t destroy the evidence you found at my neck.

opening_if.zh: 那不是诊费能解释的治疗。
opening_if.en: That treatment wasn’t covered by the consultation fee.

opening_if.zh: 关于Vael。明晚，我把剩下的说完。
opening_if.en: About Vael. Tomorrow, I’ll tell you the rest.

reply.zh: 我已经注意到了。正努力表现得无所谓。
reply.en: I noticed. I’m trying to look unaffected.

reply.zh: 你会得到。玩笑不能顶账。
reply.en: You’ll get it. Jokes don’t pay that debt.

opening.zh: 信上的那条，我早就知道。明晚当面说清。
opening.en: I knew about that clause. Tomorrow, in person.

options.en: Was keeping me in the dark clever?

reply.zh: 聪明，不等于正确。这次我不躲问题。
reply.en: Clever doesn’t mean right. I’m not dodging that question.

options.zh: 明晚别用调情转移话题。
options.en: No flirting your way out tomorrow.

reply.zh: 收到。你比王庭会立规矩。
reply.en: Understood. You set better rules than the court.

opening.zh: 明晚先交出王位。实际签名，不只承诺。
opening.en: Tomorrow I give up the throne first. A signature, not another promise.

reply.en: Then I really shouldn’t take the easy way out.

options.en: Tonight, you can just be Rhys.

opening_if.zh: 刚才不是条款漏洞。是你主动的那一下。
opening_if.en: That wasn’t a loophole. It was you making the move.

opening_if.zh: 你给的规矩，记起来很容易。
opening_if.en: Your rules are remarkably easy to remember.

opening_if.zh: 谢谢你没有把我当成一个待解决的问题。
opening_if.en: Thank you for not treating me like a problem to solve.

reply.en: I will. You won’t pay my bill.

reply.zh: 普通这个标准，我会努力达到。
reply.en: Ordinary. A standard I’ll work hard to meet.

opening.zh: 今日身份：普通室友。今日挑战：咖啡。
opening.en: Today’s title: ordinary roommate. Today’s challenge: coffee.

reply.en: Cup’s on the counter. I’m beside you.
All right. This time it’s simply you calling me.

opening.zh: 两个形态，一份家务。我提出异议。
opening.en: Two forms. One chore list. I object.

reply.zh: 你让我恢复自由，又剥夺了我偷懒的权利。
reply.en: You restored my freedom and revoked my right to be lazy.

options.en: Choose the human form and come here first.

reply.zh: 选择已做出。接下来轮到你。

opening.zh: 公文办完。下一次是私人来访。
opening.en: Official business finished. Next visit is personal.

reply.zh: 收到。这个任务比废止条款更有压力。
reply.en: Understood. More pressure than repealing the clause.

reply.zh: 当然。这一次，只有你能邀请我。
reply.en: Of course. This time only you can invite me.
